page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Excretory Products and their Elimination · 2 marks

steps.label: What it is made of
steps.why: The apparatus sits where the distal tubule touches its own glomerulus, so it can sense the filtrate and act on the blood supply at the same place.
common_mistakes: Naming only one of the two parts.
Placing it in the medulla. It lies in the cortex, beside the glomerulus.
steps.memory_tip: Juxta means beside: it sits beside the glomerulus.
steps.margin_note: Name both parts in one line.
lines: The macula densa together with the juxta

steps.label: What it does
steps.why: It releases renin when the filtration falls, which raises blood pressure and restores the filtering.
common_mistakes: Writing that it filters blood. It regulates, it does not filter.
steps.memory_tip: It is the kidney's own control switch.

lines.text: It regulates kidney function and secretes renin

insider_note: Two parts, two marks: name macula densa and the juxtaglomerular cells, then say it regulates kidney function.
